list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Add SEO metadata, robots.txt, and sitemap for search engine optimization
- Update `index.html` with enhanced meta tags, Open Graph properties, Twitter Cards, and Schema.org JSON-LD structured data. - Create `robots.txt` to define crawler access and reference the sitemap. - Create `sitemap.xml` to index the landing page URL.

MESSAGE.value:
Add landing page structure, styles, and interactivity for Integridade Sergipe Consultoria
- Add `index.html` featuring hero, program, methodology, plans, about, and modal sections. - Create `styles.css` with custom styling, variables, animations, and responsive layout. - Add `script.js` to manage mobile navigation, legal modal dialogs, and scroll reveal effects. - Include brand assets, favicon, web manifest, and `.gitignore` file.

Reduce methodology from 5 to 4 phases and update plan details
- Update `index.html` to reduce methodology phases from 5 to 4 and remove training features from plans. - Adjust `styles.css` grid template columns for the methodology timeline to 4 columns.

Improve image responsiveness and update hero emblem styling
- Add global `styles.css` rules for `img` elements to ensure proper scaling and object-fit behavior. - Update `.hero-emblem` properties and responsive width constraints across media queries.

Pivot landing page from investment plans to certificate issuance and services
- Update `index.html` navigation and hero section to focus on compliance certificate issuance and services. - Replace tiered pricing plans with a single service card for specialized integrity certification under Lei 8.866/2021. - Add a dedicated contact information section and update call-to-action copy.
